runnerInheritedFromLauncher: Inherited from the shared launcher — change it from its card
retroarchNotInstalledDesc: RetroArch is not installed. Install it to launch ROMs.
noCoreCompatible: No compatible core found for this system.
noAdditionalCompatOptions: No additional compatibility options for this runner.
persistentCaption: Saved: will also apply to every future launch of the game.
notPersistentCaption: Not saved: will apply only to the next installation, then forgotten.
disableWineSyncDesc: Enable only if installation hangs while creating the Wine environment for no apparent reason. Slightly slows down Wine's internal synchronization, but avoids a known hang on some systems during this phase.
useKnownFixesDesc: Looks up known dependencies for this game in Heroic Games Launcher's public database before installation. If found, they replace the verbs configured below. If the game isn't covered, you'll get a notification and the default verbs will be used.
scrapeTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Guardians (if the ROM name isn't recognizable)
